scope: Real pixel evidence -> deterministic Retina features/change gate -> adaptive MVC0 familiarity/open-set -> typed VisualPercept -> same FRANK H1 runtime with optional peer/GWT/UnifiedDB -> host-authorized real sandbox effect -> outcome/recovery re-entry.
visual_invariants: Pixel/frame hashes and transparent numerical features are deterministic for identical images.
Visual evidence authority remains OBSERVATION_ONLY; familiarity remains FAMILIARITY_ROUTING_ONLY.
GOLD can train; SILVER requires repeated distinct support; BRONZE cannot self-promote.
Unknown and conflict remain explicit epistemic states and do not become semantic truth.
Prototype versions are rollbackable and feature-version mismatches are rejected.
Learning budgets can pause adaptation without disabling perception.
Familiar fast path and deep-perception escalation are separate routing outcomes.

negative_results.finding: Initial MVC0 open-set threshold was too permissive: a deliberately novel cross pattern was classified as KNOWN_NEEDS_CONFIRMATION.
negative_results.resolution: Raised sandbox confirmation calibration after comparing same-class perturbations against distinct negative patterns; regression now rejects deliberate novel samples in the current fixture family.

negative_results.finding: Effect semantic receipts originally included absolute sandbox paths.
negative_results.resolution: Removed host-root identity from semantic effect state; current organism uses root-independent effect semantics.

limitations: The visual backbone is a transparent deterministic sandbox feature extractor, not CLIP/DINO or a production vision model.
The peer is a typed deterministic Claude fixture, not live Claude Code transport.
The local 4B slot remains an ABI/proposal fixture, not live target Qwen-class inference.
Performance numbers are sandbox proxies, not Andreas target-PC measurements.
